_comment: rust-code-analysis baseline (T1174): named functions with cyclomatic>15 or cognitive>20. CI fails on NEW violations or worsened ones; prune entries that no longer violate.

violations.justification: S8A: one arm per special form plus sibling/prim dispatch; the subset call classifier stays exhaustive

one arm per Expr variant; arms delegate to small-step helpers. S5B adds the WithRedefs/WithBindings/BoundFn arms; S5C the DefMacro/Declare/Ns arms. S5D adds the Assert/CaseStar/LazySeqStar/Time/WithOutStr arms. S6A adds the DelayStar arm. S6D adds the Locking arm. S-instream adds the WithInStr arm.

one arm per special form; dispatch to per-form parsers. S5B adds the with-redefs/with-bindings/bound-fn arms; S5C the defmacro/declare/ns arms. S5D adds the assert/time/with-out-str/lazy-seq*/case* arms. S6A adds the delay* arm. S6D adds the locking arm. S-instream adds the with-in-str arm.

one arm per class name; load-error class table stays exhaustive. S5D extends the table with the core/format throw-site classes (ArithmeticException, format exceptions, IO, IllegalState, FileNotFound). S6B adds ExecutionException/CancellationException. S6C adds RejectedExecutionException. S-instream adds the ReaderException spellings. S7 adds ClassNotFoundException. S12 adds the chunk array exceptions (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, NegativeArraySizeException). S15 adds the ArrayStore/OutOfMemory arms (ArrayIndexOutOfBounds/NegativeArraySize already covered by S12). Fence 4b F8b adds the IllegalMonitorStateException arm (unmatched monitor-exit).
pure enum-to-name string table, one arm per ThrowClass variant; fence 4b F8b adds the IllegalMonitorStateException arm, tripping the 15-arm threshold
S15: one arm per (BaseType, dims, val-shape) overload match; the direct-aset shape table stays exhaustive
S15: one arm per BaseType unbox rule; the Array.set tail table stays exhaustive
S15: one arm per (ctor, scalar-vs-seq-vs-size) shape incl. per-base narrowing/cast rules; the ctor dispatch stays exhaustive
S15: keyword dispatch plus per-Elem8 validation; the vector-of front stays exhaustive
S15: one arm per SetX coercion; the def-aset table stays exhaustive
S15: ref-tail assignability per store shape; the narrow/dims>1 matrix stays exhaustive
S15: one arm per Elem8 ArrayManager coercion; the vector-of table stays exhaustive

fence 3b: one arm per Value variant plus scalar shapes; the content-hash table stays exhaustive so Box clones of the same value share a monitor. Fence 3c rebase: Executor arm (41->42, forced by the new variant; same minted-id shape as Agent)
